card_en: Where something is: after v, na and pri the noun takes the locative. Feminine -a becomes -i: v kuhinji. Masculine and neuter nouns take -u: v hladilniku, v stanovanju. Going somewhere keeps the accusative: grem v kuhinjo.

example.en: The milk is in the fridge.

m.loc.note_en: Most masculine nouns add -u: vrt, na vrtu.

f.loc.note_en: Every feminine noun in -a works the same way: miza, na mizi.

quick_check.explain_en: This says where the bread is, so kuhinja takes the locative: v kuhinji.

helper_de: German uses the dative for where: in der Küche. Slovenian has a case of its own for it, the locative: v kuhinji.
helper_en: English changes the little word, in or into. Slovenian keeps v and changes the ending: v kuhinji, v kuhinjo.
